description: Gemini generateContent with text and an inline PNG, traced by the official OTel Google GenAI instrumentation.
notes: Content is requested on spans: OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental and OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=span_only. GoogleGenAiSdkInstrumentor sets OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_EMIT_EVENT=true while instrumenting generate_content; this span has no events, and the message content is on gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. The image is a 64x64 PNG generated in the program, stored as a blob part. Usage copies promptTokenCount 90 and cachedContentTokenCount 40 as they are. prices.json has no Gemini model row.
